estimates.assumptions: 2 average boneless skinless chicken breasts (approx 8 oz / 225 g total raw edible portion); plain meat has zero carbs/fiber
12 oz / 340 g raw carrots, peeled and roasted with minimal oil; standard raw carrot carb/fiber values scaled to full quantity
5 medium russet potatoes (approx 1.5 lb / 680 g total raw, peeled weight after dicing); standard raw potato carb/fiber values scaled to full quantity
1 medium-large yellow onion (approx 150 g raw, peeled and sliced); standard raw onion carb/fiber values scaled to full quantity
1 unit beef stock concentrate / bouillon (standard single-serve packet or tsp equivalent, ~5-6 g); typical values for beef bouillon
1.5 cups shredded low-moisture mozzarella (approx 170 g); standard mozzarella carb values scaled to full quantity
2 tbsp full-fat sour cream (approx 30 g); standard sour cream carb values scaled to full quantity
2 tbsp butter used in mashed potatoes (standard modest amount for this recipe scale); pure fat has zero carbs/fiber
1 tsp granulated sugar for onions (modest 'to taste' amount); standard sugar carb values scaled to full quantity
approx 1 tbsp total vegetable oil actually absorbed/used across all cooking steps (onions, carrots, chicken); pure oil has zero carbs/fiber
salt to taste; negligible and unknown exact amount used
pepper to taste; negligible and unknown exact amount used
